svg.title: Requirement ledger
svg.desc: Brief requirement: Native invisible runtime, trusted input, persistent authentication, shared CLI/MCP, Planned proof: Existing full suite plus new command MCP conformance; Brief requirement: Memory-aware scheduling, Planned proof: Heavy fixture admission/queue tests and full responsible-process memory samples; Brief requirement: Agent/task tab ownership and serial mutations, Planned proof: Two owners contend for one tab; distinct tabs progress independently; Brief requirement: Pressure reclamation protects active commands, downloads, unsaved work and handoffs, Planned proof: Public pressure/configuration scenarios for each protected state; Brief requirement: Bounded connections, queues and retained output, Planned proof: Resource-limit rejection, fair drain, bounded recent events, oversized input tests; Brief requirement: Batched commands, Planned proof: Ordered execution with indexed receipts and early stop; Brief requirement: Action receipts, Planned proof: Click/fill receipts match visible outcomes on native-input fixtures; Brief requirement: Event subscriptions, Planned proof: URL/DOM/dialog/download/network conditions without unbounded polling or retained listeners
